_about: Manual product-image overrides, merged over product-images.json by make_products.py (an override wins over the auto-fetched map). product-images.json is generated from Shopify product endpoints (.js/.json) and can only cover Shopify retailers. Retailers without such an endpoint (today: Amazon) are recorded HERE instead. Rules: image_url must be the main product image served by that product's OWN retailer listing page (its #landingImage / featured image) - never a stock photo, never another retailer's image, never a URL guessed from the title. Each record states the source page and how the image was confirmed. If a page stops yielding its image, remove the record rather than substituting one.
